'''Twin Suns Eight''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within [[Twin Suns Squadron]]. During the [[Second Battle of Bilbringi]], Twin Suns Eight accompanied [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to commandeer the [[Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun]] that suddenly appeared.<ref name="FP" />

==Appearances==
*''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''
